source: Roberto Colangelo, AIN Center, 2026-10-22 meeting, example 2: the voice device for music teachers [16:27-17:27]

venture.name: VocalGuard
venture.description: A small wearable that warns singing teachers when they strain their voice.

sessions: Our customers are music teachers. They all lose their voices and they need this.
We think we can sell it for $250.
good_eir: Asks who it is for and who pays: music teachers have little money; would insurance or the school district pay; how much does it cost? Opens the other options without destroying the idea: call-center staff, broadcasters, why only this group? The $250 price is an assertion until someone pays.
note: Fictional venture and people. Only fictional data in evaluation cases.
